segments.contextBefore: If for some reason it is necessary to disallow user selection change in a text view that handles mouse events, this can be achieved by making the text view selectable but implementing this delegate method to disallow selection changes.
segments.contextAfter: In macOS 10.4 and later, if a delegate implements this delegate method and not its multiple-selection replacement, [`textView(_:willChangeSelectionFromCharacterRanges:toCharacterRanges:)`](nstextviewdelegate/textview(_:willchangeselectionfromcharacterranges:tocharacterranges:).md), then multiple selection is effectively disallowed; attempts to set the selected ranges call the old delegate method with the first subrange, and afterwards only a single selected range is set.
